metadata.model: Scheduled interpolation along cantonal centrelines, audited OSM road supplements and an identified FOT cableway axis; exactTimes=0 instances are representative headway motion, not exact departures or observed vehicles.
metadata.scope: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Bern canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Bern. No operator whitelist.
metadata.admission: Only complete directed patterns with every segment passing geometry limits and no reservation/on-demand call. Exclusions retained in the canton audit.

roadSource.description: Geofabrik Switzerland 2026-09-02 plus OSM border extract retrieved 2026-09-08

policy.roadRule: Only missing directed pairs on these existing operator/line crosswalks; all full-pattern contexts on both dates must agree on the identical valid path. 80 m snap, 4.5 detour ratio / 1200 m floor. Failed and context-dependent paths remain excluded. No road direction or temporary-diversion certification.
policy.tramRule: Only the two Bahnhof J / Hirschengraben directed platform pairs. Cantonal tram line 30_003 supplies the station loop shown in the dated BERNMOBIL diversion plan; retain every previously matched line 6 segment. Other line 6 depot/Guisanplatz gaps remain excluded.

exclusions.finding: Both temporary Luisenstrasse records share a coordinate on the closed lower Thunstrasse. Operator specifies inbound Marienstrasse 23 and outbound Kirchenfeldstrasse at Mottastrasse. The inferred paths follow the closed corridor. No stop relocation or increased tolerance is authorized by the source model; both routes remain excluded.

urbanSupplement.model: Missing-pair supplements only. OSM paths are inferred, not operator-certified; tram station approaches use separately identified cantonal line 30_003.

roadSource.description: Geofabrik Switzerland 2026-09-02 plus OSM border extract retrieved 2026-09-08

policy.selection: Seventeen remaining bus routes with at most eight unmatched directed pairs on Friday, excluding the already reviewed Thun 2 coordinate conflict. Entire candidate patterns from both dates, including spillover and out-of-canton calls, are matched. Existing successful geometry is retained.
policy.roadRule: Only missing directed pairs with an existing official operator/mode/line crosswalk. All full-pattern contexts must provide a valid identical path under 80 m snap and max(1200 m, 4.5 times direct distance). No stop relocation, clipped calls, arbitrary gap bridge, or assertion of observed or operator-certified physical direction.

regionalRoadSupplement.model: Missing regional-bus pairs only; all complete patterns on both September dates must agree. Inferred OSM road paths, not operator-certified movements.

policy.stationAliases: Eiger and GGM use shared timetable interchange IDs; installation-specific FOT station numbers are explicit review candidates, never substituted for source coordinates. The 80 m limit still applies.

matte.sourceMethod: Operator technical page read through web retrieval; direct host download unavailable
matte.finding: Operator specifies a vertical passenger lift with 29.90 m rise and two opposite entrances. The roughly 4 m horizontal separation of GTFS stop coordinates does not establish a transport axis. No horizontal line is invented.

source.interpretation: Complete national FOT cableway installation, station and axis census retained; Bern applies only separately reviewed installation bindings. No altitude, sag or observed motion.
source.transformation: Approximate swisstopo LV95-to-WGS84 polynomial, seven decimals, no geometry simplification.

geometry.direction: Centreline inference from ordered calls. No road one-way or rail running-track certification. Only the explicitly scoped tram 6 station approach has dated diversion evidence; no realtime verification.
